gates.name: SOURCE_FREEZE
gates.evidence: freeze_public_plugin_source.py run on the frozen worktree: commit/tree 40-hex, exact eight skill names, path->sha256 for all 48 files, canonicalised text members; raw output evidence/08_PLUGIN/FROZEN_SOURCE_LEDGER.json
gates.not_claimed: the tag crosswalk and the vendor asset digests are read from the GitHub API, not re-downloaded this round

gates.name: SOURCE_IMMUTABLE
gates.evidence: evidence/08_PLUGIN/WRITESET_GUARD.txt: diff against the stacked Stage-A base lists zero paths outside the upgrade set, zero writes under skills/**, src/** or schemas/**, zero writes under dist/**
gates.not_claimed: the guard is computed against the stacked base; the Stage-A core writes it inherits are the owner's to ratify on the Stage-A PR

gates.name: EXACT_SKILLS
gates.evidence: ledger skill set == the eight frozen names; the builder refuses a ninth directory (test_07) and any member absent from the ledger (test_06)

gates.name: SEMANTIC_PROJECTION
gates.evidence: byte-exact for every non-SKILL member; the derived SKILL.md asserts the body is unchanged (test_12) and marks the row DERIVED_WITH_OWNER_APPROVAL
gates.residual: no real subject can be projected yet: all eight packs carry non-portable frontmatter and no owner derivation record exists, so the real build refuses (REAL_BUILD_ATTEMPT.txt)

gates.name: PACKAGE_FORMAT
gates.evidence: official Agent Plugins manifest validated against a byte-locked vendor schema (28 packaging cases); deterministic ZIP with member read-back; structural PNG decode; no mcp/app/hooks member
gates.residual: the vendor's own validator and the Portal scan are NOT_EXECUTED; the local validators are ours (stdlib), declared in the ADR

gates.name: RELEASE_PROVENANCE
gates.evidence: two builds from identical inputs are byte-identical (test_10); the real subject build is attempted and REFUSED at the first owner gate with no archive written
gates.residual: a real artifact digest cannot exist until the owner supplies the four inputs; a new immutable release is required and the owner owns the tag

gates.name: SKILL_BEHAVIOR
gates.evidence: Hermes Agent: project-local trust declared 8/8 load and a one-shot session listed all eight skills (POS); a non-PIPD question triggered no workflow (NON-TRIGGER). Stage A executed the Codex CLI host UAT.
gates.residual: typed-refusal and adversarial scenarios were not run on a host this round; no per-skill trigger/negative matrix

gates.name: WEB_CONSUMER
gates.evidence: no public directory listing exists, so the documented Web route is the single fallback document; its generator is tested (16 cases) and refuses rather than truncates
gates.residual: no real Plus or Free account UAT; no document generated from a real published mount

gates.name: AGENT_CONSUMER
gates.evidence: Hermes Agent executed locally; Codex CLI executed in Stage A; both are scoped to their own host
gates.residual: Codex Desktop (GUI) and Claude Code were NOT_EXECUTED; no host may be described as universally verified

gates.name: PUBLIC_RELEASE
gates.evidence: no verified publisher identity, no Portal draft, no scan, no review, no publish; the four owner inputs are listed in packaging/public-plugin/OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED.json
gates.residual: the agent performs none of these acts
